title: The Good Samaritan
summaryZh: 我們不能靠好行為得救，唯有神的憐憫與深愛能拯救我們脫離罪惡。
ref: 約翰一書 5:13, 路加福音 10:33
lines: People say they can be saved by doing the best they can.
人們說只要盡力做到最好就能得救。
I saw a poll in New Jersey some time ago that said ninety-two percent of the people said they hope to go to heaven, but they were not sure.
不久前我在紐澤西州看到一項民調顯示，百分之九十二的人說他們希望能上天堂，但他們並不確定。
But John said, "We know that we've passed from death unto life."
但約翰說：「我們知道我們已經出死入生了。」
Peter said, "For as much as ye know that you were redeemed."
Paul said, "I know in whom I have believed and am persuaded that He is able to keep that which I've committed unto Him against that day."
保羅說：「因為知道我所信的是誰，也深信祂能保全我所交付祂的，直到那日。」
The apostle John said, "These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God, that ye may know that ye have eternal life."
使徒約翰說：「我將這些話寫給你們信奉神兒子之名的人，要叫你們知道自己有永生。」
You don't have to doubt it.
Do you doubt that you're going to heaven tonight?
你懷疑今晚自己能否上天堂嗎？
Do you doubt that you have eternal life?
你懷疑自己是否有永生嗎？
Do you doubt that your sins are forgiven?
你懷疑自己的罪是否已蒙赦免嗎？
Is there a doubt in your heart?
If there is, then I'd make sure, tonight!
如果有的話，今晚就來確定吧！
You say, "I've been baptized, I've been confirmed, I've done everything I was told to do," but you're not sure.
你說：「我受過洗，我堅信過，我做了一切吩咐我做的事」，但你還是不確定。
重新將你的生命交託給神。
Reconfirm what your parents promised at baptism.
重新確認你父母在你受洗時所應許的。
Many people need to do that.
I was brought up in the church; baptized, confirmed, and all the rest.
我在教會長大；受洗、堅信禮，以及一切的儀式我都經歷過。
But I still didn't really know Christ as my Savior and my Lord.
但我仍然沒有真正認識基督是我個人的救主和主宰。
There came a time when I had to say, "Yes, Lord, I will receive You, I will turn from my sins, I will allow You to change my way of living."
直到有一個時刻，我必須說：「是的，主啊，我要接受祢，我要轉離我的罪，我要讓祢改變我的生活方式。」
"Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to His mercy He saved us."
「祂便救了我們，並不是因我們自己所行的義，乃是照祂的憐憫。」
So the wounded, derelict man was left to die; the priest and the Levite unwilling to save him.
所以那受傷、被遺棄的人就被留在原地等死；祭司和利未人不願意救他。
And Jesus now shows us the simplicity and the saving power of the gospel.
現在耶穌向我們展現了福音的簡單明瞭與拯救大能。
「惟有一個撒馬利亞人行路來到那裡……」
Now a Samaritan was a half-caste; he was half Gentile and half Jewish.
撒馬利亞人是混血兒；他有一半外邦人血統，一半猶太人血統。
The Jews and the Gentiles at that time had nothing to do with each other, and certainly the Jews and the Samaritans had nothing to do with each other.
當時的猶太人和外邦人互不往來，猶太人和撒馬利亞人更是如此。
They didn't trust each other in that ancient day.
在那個古老的時代，他們互不信任。
They do today, but they didn't at that time.
他們今天會，但在當時並不會。
And so this Samaritan, who normally would have nothing to do with somebody of another ethnic background, came along and saw what happened.
所以這位平常不會和其他種族背景的人有任何瓜葛的撒馬利亞人，走過來並看到了發生的事。
Now he could have said to himself, "I have no responsibility for this guy.
他本來可以在心裡說：「我對這個人沒有責任。
He got in his own trouble.
He should have come along armed and ready for the thieves and the robbers on this road.
他走這條路本該帶上武器，防備盜賊和強盜。
I don't have any responsibility towards him.
He's not related to me, he hates me."
他跟我非親非故，而且他恨我。」
God could have done the same with us.
神本來也可以這樣對待我們。
He could have looked at this little planet whirling out into space like a speck of dust, with little ants called people living on it.
祂大可以看著這顆在太空中旋轉、像一粒微塵般的小行星，上面住著被稱為人類的小螞蟻。
Lost, separated from Him, dying, being born, live a few years and then die; being born, live a few years and die, and sin and go on with their own pleasures defying God.
迷失、與祂隔絕、步向死亡、出生、活幾年然後死去；再次出生、活幾年然後死去，繼續犯罪並在屬肉體的享樂中悖逆神。
And He could have said, "Sweep them all into hell."
祂大可以說：「把他們全掃進地獄吧。」
He could have said, "Let's destroy the planet."
祂大可以說：「我們來毀滅這顆星球吧。」
He could have done it with a snap of His finger.
祂只要彈個指頭就能做到。
He could have done it with an order to one angel.
祂只要向一位天使下達命令就能做到。
The Bible says, "For God so loved the world."
You don't understand that, do you?
